mapper.sql: select o.production_order_id, o.production_order_no, o.sales_order_id, o.sales_order_no, o.customer_id, o.customer_name, o.plan_start_date, o.plan_finish_date, o.total_qty, o.completed_qty, o.order_status, d.item_summary, ifnull(p.picking_posted_flag, 0) as picking_posted_flag, o.audit_by, o.audit_time, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from erp_production_order o left join ( select production_order_id, group_concat(concat_ws(' / ', style_no, style_name, color_name, size_name) order by production_order_detail_id separator '; ') as item_summary from erp_production_order_detail group by production_order_id ) d on d.production_order_id = o.production_order_id left join ( select source_no, max(case when outbound_type = '生产领料' and order_status = '已出库' then 1 else 0 end) as picking_posted_flag from erp_outbound_order group by source_no ) p on p.source_no = o.production_order_no
mapper.select:
and o.production_order_no like concat('%', #{productionOrderNo}, '%') and o.sales_order_no like concat('%', #{salesOrderNo}, '%') and o.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and o.order_status = #{orderStatus} and date_format(o.plan_start_date, '%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime}, '%Y%m%d') and date_format(o.plan_finish_date, '%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime}, '%Y%m%d')
order by o.plan_finish_date asc, o.production_order_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into erp_production_order(production_order_no, sales_order_id, sales_order_no, customer_id, customer_name, plan_start_date, plan_finish_date, total_qty, completed_qty, order_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{productionOrderNo}, #{salesOrderId}, #{salesOrderNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{planStartDate}, #{planFinishDate}, #{totalQty}, #{completedQty}, #{orderStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update erp_production_order set sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}, sales_order_no = #{salesOrderNo}, customer_id = #{customerId}, customer_name = #{customerName}, plan_start_date = #{planStartDate}, plan_finish_date = #{planFinishDate}, total_qty = #{totalQty}, completed_qty = #{completedQty}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and order_status = '草稿'

update erp_production_order set order_status = '已下达', audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and order_status = '草稿'

update erp_production_order set order_status = '已完成', completed_qty = total_qty, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and order_status in ('已下达', '裁剪中', '缝制中', '后整中')

update erp_production_order set order_status = '已关闭', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and order_status in ('草稿', '已下达', '裁剪中', '缝制中', '后整中')
mapper.delete: delete from erp_production_order where order_status = '草稿' and production_order_id in #{productionOrderId}
